Name: Muyi's ToolBox
Author: MuYi12
Description:
Description
One console, every tool. Muyi's ToolBox is a growing command toolbox for Stardew Valley: instead of installing a separate mod for every little cheat or convenience, you get one SMAPI console hub that keeps gaining new tools with every update. Version 1.0 ships with the trinket toolbox — unlock the trinket slot instantly using the exact same logic the game's own Combat Mastery uses, no all-skills grinding, no Mastery Cave run required. More tools are already on the way: item spawning, skill controls, time & weather, and whatever the community asks for.

Installation
1. Install SMAPI (4.0.0 or later).
2. Unzip the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
3. Launch the game with SMAPI, load a save, and type `tb` in the SMAPI console — that's the whole tutorial.

Main features
- `tb` — the toolbox index: lists every command the box can do today.
- `trinket unlock` — unlock the trinket slot (same stat the vanilla Combat Mastery grants), works on any save.
- `trinket status` — check your trinket slots and mastery experience at a glance.
- Zero UI clutter: no menus, no overlays — everything lives in the console, exactly where a toolbox belongs.
- Roadmap: item & skill tools, time and weather controls, and more every update.

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0.0+
- Works in single player and multiplayer (commands affect your own farmer).

Shout outs
Thanks to ConcernedApe for the game and its wonderfully hackable 1.6 update, and to the SMAPI team for the modding framework this box is built on.
